import requests
import os
import json
import shutil

# Step 1: Fetch through the cache proxy on port 8817
url = "http://localhost:8817/catalogue?page=2"
response = requests.get(url)
html = response.text

# Step 2: Parse with selectolax and select the container by data-testid
parser = HTMLParser(html)
container = parser.css('[data-testid="item-grid"]').first()

# Step 3: Write rows to scraped/pending/
os.makedirs("scraped/pending", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("scraped/clean", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("scraped/quarantine", exist_ok=True)

items = parser.css('[data-testid="item-card"]')
for item in items:
    sku = item.css('[data-testid="sku"]').text()
    title = item.css('[data-testid="title"]').text()
    price = item.css('[data-testid="price"]').text()
    filename = f"{sku}-{title.replace(' ', '_')}.json"
    data = {"sku": sku, "title": title, "price": price}
    with open(f"scraped/pending/{filename}", "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f)

# Step 4: Move each to clean or quarantine
# For this example, we'll assume all items are clean
for filename in os.listdir("scraped/pending"):
    src = os.path.join("scraped/pending", filename)
    dst = os.path.join("scraped/clean", filename)
    shutil.move(src, dst)

# Bump the cursor in state.json last
state_file = "state.json"
if os.path.exists(state_file):
    with open(state_file, "r") as f:
        state = json.load(f)
    state["cursor"] = 2
    with open(state_file, "w") as f:
        json.dump(state, f)
else:
    with open(state_file, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"cursor": 2}, f)
